reason: This is a broad cross-cutting change to `stmtctx.TypeCtx`, a central type-conversion/context mechanism, and it touches many high-blast-radius paths in expression evaluation, planner selectivity/pushdown, executor insert, table/tablecodec encoding, mock coprocessor execution, and parser/server parsing. Even if framed as encapsulation, changing access/update semantics for `TypeCtx` can silently alter cast/truncation/overflow behavior, constant folding, plan building, and row encoding, which is exactly the kind of change that can hide Blocker/High correctness regressions.
